verificationPolicy.rule: A source is listed here ONLY if the URL was actually opened during verification, or its existence and metadata were returned by the publisher's own catalogue API.
acceptedVerificationMethods: fetch_page on the source URL and read returned content
archive.org advancedsearch API returning identifier + title + language + creator for that exact identifier
archive.org metadata API returning the item file list for that exact identifier
archive.org full-text derivative read (title page / index page)

verificationLevels.content-read: The page itself was opened and its content read.
verificationLevels.metadata-verified: The item exists and its title/language/creator were returned by the catalogue API; the body text was not read page by page.
verificationLevels.catalogue-verified: A print-book listing (ISBN / publisher / page count) was confirmed on two independent bookseller catalogues. No free full text exists.
verificationLevels.linked-not-opened: The URL appears as a link inside a source that WAS opened, but it was not opened separately. Do not cite as an authority until opened.
verificationLevels.dead: URL was attempted and is unreachable. Listed only so nobody re-adds it.

sourceCount._note: Counted by category, not by the 'language' field, because the Navagraha sthalam entries are Tamil temple sources whose articles happen to be written in English.

sources.title: Mantreswara's Phaladeepika (Adhyayas I-XXVIII)
sources.author: Mantreswara
sources.verificationNote: Details page AND full-text derivative opened 2026-10-09. Title page confirms 'MANTRESWARA'S PHALADEEPIKA (ADHYAYAS I-XXVIII) ... SECOND EDITION - REVISED AND ENLARGED ... ARUNA PRESS, BANGALORE 1950'. The printed index was read; it confirms chapter anchors used below.
sources.caveat: A public review on the item page states that pages 82-83 are missing from the 'PDF WITH TEXT' derivative. Quote nothing from that page range.
verifiedChapterAnchors: Adhyaya I - graha and rasi basics; PARASARA cited at I-2
Adhyaya II - graha characteristics (II-34 for periods of time signified by planets; II-28 pairs of planets as parents)
Adhyaya V - bhava results and livelihood (V-3 pilgrimage to holy shrines; V-5, V-7 earning through poems)
Adhyaya VI - yogas (VI-8 papa kartari; VI-32 parivartana)
Adhyaya VII - 7th house / kalatra bhava (VII-9, 14, 25 ninth house)
Adhyaya VIII - disease and debility indicators (VIII-23 piles)
Adhyaya XIV - ailments: PAIN at XIV-9; NERVOUS DISEASES at XIV-41; 'PALPITATION - Rahu causes palpitation of the heart, XIV-9'; PHLEGM at XIV-6, 8, 14; POISON at XIV-2, 4, 5, 9, 15, 20
Adhyaya XIX - results by house (XIX-14 dismissal from an office)
Adhyaya XX - results by house and dasha (XX-4 hearing of agreeable news; XX-19 penury)
Adhyaya XXI - detailed results (XXI-22 peril; XXI-79 good news)
Adhyaya XXIII - dasha phala (results of dashas)
Adhyaya XXIV - transits and planetary factors
Adhyaya XXV - special combinations, papa vedha (XXV-1..48)
Adhyaya XXVI - GOCHARA / TRANSITS: ninth house at XXVI-2..8, 11, 15, 20, 21, 23; PENANCE at XXVI-50; planetary war at XXVI-29; PENURY at XXVI-37; ORGANS at XXVI-36
usefulFor: Gochara (transit) rules, chapter XXVI
Bhava phala house by house
Health indications (Adhyaya XIV) - astrological only, never a diagnosis
Dasha phala (Adhyaya XXIII)
Remedial penance and pilgrimage (XXVI-50, V-3)

sources.titleNative: ஸ்ரீ தர்பாரண்யேஸ்வரஸ்வாமி தேவஸ்தானம், ஸ்ரீ சனீஸ்வரபகவான் ஸ்தலம் - திருநள்ளாறு
sources.author: Sri Dharbaranyeswaraswamy Devasthanam, Thirunallar
sources.publisher: Department of Hindu Religious Institutions, Government of Puducherry
sources.verificationNote: Page opened 2026-10-09. The Tamil text on the page states that Thirunallar is சனிபகவானுக்கு உரிய பரிகாரத் தலம்; that the area was called தர்ப்பாரண்யம் because darbha grass grew thickly there and later நகவிடங்கபுரம்; that the murti is தர்ப்பாரண்யேஸ்வரர் and the ambikai பிராணேஸ்வரி; that King Nala was freed from Sani's affliction here; that it is one of the சப்தவிடங்கத் தலங்கள்; that it was sung by Apper, Sundarar and Sambandar; and specifically recommends that those who want Sani dosha removed sing the Thirugnana Sambandar pathigam beginning 'போகமார்த்த பூண்முலையாள்', known as பச்சைப் பதிகம். The page also carries the Sani Peyarchi 2026 announcement.
usefulFor: Sani / Sade Sati remedies in the Tamil tradition
A FREE, verified remedy: the Sambandar pathigam named by the temple itself
Correct administration: this temple is under the Puducherry Department of Hindu Religious Institutions, not Tamil Nadu HR&CE

sources.title: Caution note on the term 'Sade Sati'
sources.verificationNote: Opened 2026-10-09. It states that the phrase 'Sade Sati' appears in neither Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra nor Phaladeepika, and that the classical texts instead give Saturn's results house by house from the natal Moon, with Phaladeepika Adhyaya XXVI as the usual starting point. THIS IS A SECONDARY CLAIM. It is consistent with the Phaladeepika index read from EN-02, which has no 'Sade Sati' entry, but the index was only read for the letters N-P, so it is NOT a complete check. Treat as a caution, not as a proven fact.
usefulFor: Honesty guardrail: the agent must not claim a classical verse 'says Sade Sati'
Explaining Sade Sati as the later transit tradition's name for a period the classics describe house by house from the Moon
sources.caveat: Secondary source. Do not present as verified against the primary texts.
